correctness.rationale: All nontrivial thresholds are distinct on the full product. In an arbitrary version space, a coordinate can make exactly j of its retained thresholds true for every j between zero and its retained threshold count. Independent coordinates fill the entire allowed interval, adjusted by whichever constants are present, so every version space of size at least two admits a balanced split. Induction and the distinct-hypothesis leaf bound give the general finite-palette online formula. Statically, each coordinate supplies at most its available number of nonconstant traces. For s>=3, pair each proper set not containing 1 with its union with {1}, except where this would use the full set. The two uncovered sets {1} and [s] minus {1} can be absorbed by replacing the pair ({2},{1,2}) with ({1},{1,2}) and ({2},[s] minus {1}); strict inclusions hold even for s=3. Choose as many pairs as ternary coordinates permit and assign leftover traces individually to binary coordinates, possible by 2a+b>=2^s-2. The nested traces really do arise from the 0/1/2 assignment; singleton traces ensure distinct sample points. For s=2 two independent coordinates supply opposite singletons, whereas one chain cannot. This also proves the exact one-coordinate exceptions; two quaternary features give Ldim=3 by the eight-hypothesis law but cannot cover three incomparable singletons, so VC=2.
residual_risks: This is a one-polarity one-atom class on a full product, with both constants. The arbitrary finite-palette extension concerns Littlestone dimension only. No fresh numerical run or formal verification is claimed.

value.rationale: This is an exact capacity law for a natural restricted learning class, not a sampled value or an arbitrary alphabet slice. Mixed binary and ternary features cover all product mixtures of the two smallest nontrivial palettes, and an elementary but nonautomatic trace matching establishes that adaptation gives no advantage in exactly this regime apart from the stated one-coordinate exception. The two-four-valued-feature example gives a minimal palette change that breaks the uniform equality and explains the distinct static obstruction.
residual_risks: No complete VC classification for larger palettes or extension to correlated feature domains is claimed.
